observation_summary: The system failed to prevent calling a real method on an interface, which is an invalid operation in Mockito. The test expected an exception to be thrown, but the code proceeded without validation.
reasoning_summary: The fix introduces a new validation check (`validateMockingConcreteClass`) that inspects whether the method being called belongs to an interface. Since the bug was caused by the absence of this guard, it is a classic 'Checking' defect.
evidence_used: The fix adds a new conditional check: 'if (invocation.getMethod().getDeclaringClass().isInterface())'
The test case 'shouldFailWhenCallingRealMethodOnIterface' expects an exception to be thrown when calling a real method on an interface, which was not happening before the fix.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: The fix is not about changing the computational logic of the method call itself, but about adding a guard to validate the state before the operation proceeds.
This is a local validation check, not a design-level capability gap.
